that pulls these in fixed — an override is the only lever available.

sits inside the range its dependents ask for. Left alone deliberately:
image-size  1.2.1, patched at 2.0.3  — a major bump into Metro's internals

time over assets and stylesheets from this repository. There is no attacker on
that path: the inputs are files we wrote. Forcing them would risk breaking the
bundler for all four apps to close a hole nobody can reach. Nothing here ships
in an app binary. Revisit when a future Expo SDK moves them.
